declare.en: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. If any of the rolls are a 6, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

declare.en: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

effect.en: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

declare.en: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Each time this unit attacks with its **Cometstrike Sceptre**, if the attack scores a hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick this unit if it is **in the Celestial Realm**.

effect.en: Subtract the current battle round number from 10 to determine this unit’s strike zone. Set up this unit on the battlefield more than a number of inches equal to its strike zone from all enemy units.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase

declare.en: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** units wholly within 6" of this unit to be the targets.

effect.en:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons.
If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

declare.en: Pick this unit and another visible friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit within 3" of it to be the targets.

effect.en: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for the targets, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar.*

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

While this unit has 5-9 damage points, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. 

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

Enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot pass through or end any move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.

This unit has **WARD (4+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

effect.en: If a friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

declare.en: Pick a visible faction terrain feature within 18" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

effect.en: This unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place both **Gryph-hounds** next to it.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

declare.en: If this unit was not set up this turn and any of this unit’s **Gryph‑hounds** are on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 1, remove 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** from the battlefield. On a 2+, pick 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** that is next to this unit or next to an enemy unit and place it next to the target instead.

While any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to an enemy unit, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that unit.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to it, place those **Gryph-hounds** next to this unit.

effect.en:
While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls made by the target for the rest of the turn.

effect.en: If the target is a non-**MONSTER** unit, inflict D6 mortal damage on it. If the target is a **MONSTER**, inflict D6+3 mortal damage on it.

effect.en: Add 3 to each target’s control score for the rest of the turn. In addition, **Heal (D3)** each target.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target until the start of your next turn:

***Blinding Gales:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

***Meteor-hail:*** Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons.

***Flash-freezing Blizzard:*** Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Apex Maw** is 2.

timing.en: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **WARD (4+)**. Remove this unit’s **Gryph-hound** from the battlefield at the end of the turn.
This unit’s **Gryph-hound** is a token. If this unit’s **Gryph-hound** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Gryph-hound’s Beak** and it cannot use the ‘Loyal Companion’ ability.

declare.en: Pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
For the rest of the turn:

• Friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are contesting the target.
• Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units while they are contesting the target.

effect.en: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
Each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent.
If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (4)** this unit.

This unit’s **Gryph-hound** is a token. This unit has **WARD (5+)** while its **Gryph-hound** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-hound** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

effect.en: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have **WARD (5+)**.

effect.en: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
